snippet.title: Shadows of the Dungeon | 3D Tactical Dungeon Crawler RPG (Kickstarter Teaser)
snippet.description:
Kickstarter Pre-launch page:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zartgames/shadows-of-the-dungeon-55e-compatible-dungeon-crawler-rpg

Wishlist and Play the Demo on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5213750/Shadows_of_the_Dungeon/

Join our Discord:

https://discord.gg/bcWkFprBf9

Shadows of the Dungeon is a first-person tactical dungeon crawler built entirely in 3D, featuring party-based real-time combat, optional tactical pause, and hybrid movement (classic grid-based or modern free movement). Built on the 2024 5th Edition SRD 5.2.1 ruleset in Godot Engine using C#.

Follow the Kickstarter campaign to get notified when we launch, or try the free demo on Steam.

Key features:

Full 3D environments, monsters, and tactical encounters

4 to 6 character party creation and management

2024 5e mechanics (SRD 5.2.1)

Real-time combat with tactical pause and auto-pause options

Classic grid-step navigation or free movement mode

Follow Zart Games
Website: https://zartgames.com/shadowsofthedungeon/



#dungeoncrawl #oldschoolrpg  #crpg  #indierpg #godot #legendofgrimrock #dnd #dnd5e
